title: cl blend
parentNote: cl is the other half of yesterday's pair: the same l on the end, but the word now opens at the back of the mouth with a c instead of at the lips with a b. That makes clock and block the two words to keep side by side, because a child who is guessing will swap them, and there is a listening activity today that asks for exactly that. The other slip is the same one as yesterday — a little vowel creeping in, so club comes out "cuh-lub". Get the c and the l on their own, slowly, then run them together with nothing between. Four new blends in one week is a lot of new beginnings; if they are flagging, do the story and leave the review.

activities.mouthCue: Hump the back of your tongue up and pop it for the c, then flick the tip up behind your teeth for the l.
activities.prompt: Two letters, two sounds, said in a hurry. No little vowel in the middle.
You know all three of these now. They all end with an l. Which one starts at the back of your mouth?
Two of these are one sound on its own. Find the pair.
Say the c and the l on their own first, then push them together.
Now keep cl in one piece. Three sounds: cl, i, p.
A blend on the front and a blend on the back.
One of these has an extra sound at the front. Listen before the vowel.
Same start, same ending. Listen hard to the middle.
One starts at the back of your mouth and one starts at your lips. Listen to the very first sound.

activities.text: A red clock is up on the shed.
They did clap and then the hen did cluck.
Jen and Ted sat on the cliff and did munch clams.

activities.title: The clock in the club
activities.prompt: Read the story one line at a time. Tap any word you want to hear again.
lines: Ted and Jen got a club in the shed up on the hill.
They did set a big red clock up on a shelf.
At ten the clock did clang and did not stop.
Jen did clap and Ted did clamp a sock on it!
The clock did stop at last and they got a nap in the club.

questions.prompt: Ted and Jen did set the big red clock up on ...
The clock did clang and did not stop. Ted did clamp it on.
